positions.title: Data Scientist
positions.description:
Metis is a project-based Data Science bootcamp with a focus on Machine Learning and Data Visualization. I used Python packages for data analysis, (numpy, pandas) visualization, (matplotlib, seaborn, plotly) and machine learning (sklearn, keras). I also gained experience with database management languages such as SQL and pymongo/MongoDB.

Some notable projects include:

Classifying Motion: I used Queen Mary University's MotionSense dataset to train a classifier to predict what activity someone was doing. I used Gradient Boosted Trees to classify gyroscope and accelerometer data into one of 6 activities: sitting, standing, walking, jogging, walking upstairs, or walking downstairs. I then generated data using my own iPhone to confirm that it was accurate, and it classified my motion correctly 92% of the time!

Predicting Baseball Batting Averages with Linear Regression: I used 30 annual statistics from baseball-reference.com to train a linear regression model with over 51,000 data points (unique player-year combinations) in order to predict their batting average for the next year.

positions.title: Youth Engagement Specialist
positions.description: Row New York is a nonprofit rowing team for middle and high-schoolers that offers academic support to its rowers. As a Youth Engagement Specialist, I tutored rowers in areas that they were struggling with and taught time management skills.
